item.title: New Evidence Shows School Phone Bans Are Gradually Improving Test Scores
item.dc:creator: donohoe
item.description:
A large national analysis comparing students’ scores before and after cellphone bans found modest academic improvements. Schools with strict policies requiring students to lock phones in pouches for the entire school day saw math and reading gains equivalent to roughly one or two additional weeks of schooling per year. The study was published by Harvard’s Center for Education Policy Research and is the first national study to track individual students’ growth in this way.

item.title: My AI agents found an unmapped Maya site?
item.dc:creator: eyvindn
item.description:
AI agents analyzed NASA lidar data and identified a Maya site beneath the jungle in Mexico. The site had already been mapped by archaeologists and described in Estrada-Belli et al. 2025, but it was not yet listed in Mexico’s official INAH register. The agents therefore rediscovered the site rather than discovering it, and the process took less than 72 hours to reach an official response from the Mexican government.

AI 代理分析 NASA 的激光雷达数据，在墨西哥丛林下识别出一处玛雅遗址。考古学家其实已经绘制过该遗址的地图，并在 Estrada-Belli 等人 2025 年的论文中记录了它，只是它尚未列入墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所（INAH）的官方名录。因此，代理完成的是“重新发现”而非发现；从提出想法到收到墨西哥政府的正式回复耗时不到 72 小时。

item.title: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%
item.dc:creator: slashdev
item.description:
A randomized experiment found that Google AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40% among US desktop users. The summaries now appear on more than half of the US keywords tracked by DataForSEO, up from 6% two years earlier. Generative engine optimization has not yet demonstrated a way to offset the lost traffic, while AI assistants sent websites only 0.3% of their traffic in March. The findings indicate that traditional search rankings bring substantially fewer visits when an AI answer appears above them.

一项随机实验发现，在美国桌面用户中，谷歌 AI Overviews 会让外部网站获得的点击量减少约 40%。根据 DataForSEO 的跟踪数据，这些摘要如今出现在超过一半的美国关键词结果中，而两年前这一比例仅为 6%。生成式引擎优化尚未证明能弥补这部分流量损失；3 月份，AI 助手为网站带来的流量仅占 0.3%。这表明，当 AI 答案出现在搜索结果上方时，传统排名带来的访问量会显著下降。
